newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistan interbank overnight rates remained high on Sunday due to a shortage of funds in the banking system, dealers said.
Overnight trading took place at 20 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co Ltd said. One-week funds changed hands at between 19.5 and 20 percent, the dealer said.
Another dealer said borrowers had discounted some 11 billion rupees at the State (central) Bank of Pakistan discount window.
Rates were likely to stay high on Monday, dealers said.
